svg.title: The near lane of the waterfront trail and its verge in late summer: asphalt with aggregate patches and a sealed crack, a solid white edge line, a concrete curb, a grass verge in tufts, and a scored concrete sidewalk below it. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no sign, lettering, marking symbol or figure.
